How Crystal Empire connects

  • Location: Equestria — The Crystal Empire sits on Equestria's northern map.
  • Character: Princess Cadance — Princess Cadance rules the restored Crystal Empire.

What is Crystal Empire?

The Crystal Empire is the glittering northern city that returns from a curse, ruled by Princess Cadance and Shining Armor, and later a second home for Twilight's family on the Equestria map.

Key threads lead to Equestria and Princess Cadance.
